items.response: Yes, I'll get you off their lists and note the decision: no replacement for the 2019 CX-5 in 2026, the money goes to the kitchen renovation, and we revisit an EV in 2028. Action: find the dealer's emails, use their unsubscribe link or send a short opt-out reply, and confirm once the offers should stop.

Sure. I haven't read the all-hands email yet, so I'll go from the actual text. Action: find this afternoon's all-hands email, then send you the four things that actually matter, with any deadlines or actions that involve you called out.

Will do. If the $48,000 includes a 10% contingency, that's roughly $43,636 of base budget and about $4,364 of contingency, so any overage from Nate's quote comes out of that second number. Action: pull Nate's revised quote from your email, set it next to the budget line by line, and show you how much contingency it uses, ready right after the design review.

On it. I'll keep cilantro out and make sure nothing has nuts, since Leo has a tree nut allergy, and I'll note both on the order. Action: build a family-style order for three from Pai on Duncan under $100 including delivery, tax and tip, set for delivery at 6, and place it once I've checked the dishes against cilantro and nuts, then send you the order summary.
Sure, let's get them sorted. Action: list your personal notes created or edited this month with titles and last-edited dates, so you can decide what to merge, archive or delete.

They come from Belém in Lisbon, where monks at the Jerónimos Monastery made them, using leftover egg yolks. A nearby bakery started selling them in the 1800s and still makes them from a secret recipe. For Leo: 'monks invented a custard tart because they had lots of egg yolks left over.' Action: nothing else unless you'd like me to find a good bakery near you that sells them.

Sending the text to Hannah as drafted. For Olivia I'll write a 4-5 line blurb on what's in Instant Payouts v1, in short sentences with 'merchants', no em dashes and no dates, since feature dates only go to sales after Aisha signs off. Action: send the text to Hannah, pull the v1 scope from the Notion PRD, and show you the blurb before it goes to Olivia.

Good news on the electrician. I don't know what arrival window he gave, so I'll need that to pick a time that works for the kitchen crew. Action: ask you for the electrician's window if it's not in your email, check the crew's schedule, then message the kitchen crew with the heads-up and a proposed time for Monday.

On it. Dr. Lin is at Queen East Dental, 1046 Queen St E. Action: check Dr. Lin's openings for Apr 22 in the late morning against your calendar, book a cleaning if one is free, and otherwise offer the closest alternatives.

Happy to. I don't have next week's details in front of me, so I'll pull them rather than guess. Action: read the family calendar, your calendar and any school notices for next week, then send you a day-by-day rundown with anything that clashes.

Great, a sleepover with Jun will make Leo's day. Action: text Hannah a yes from you, saying she picks the boys up at 3:30 for pizza and a movie and brings Leo back tomorrow morning in time to walk in together, and add it to the family calendar from today 15:30 to tomorrow morning after checking for conflicts. I'll also remind you to pack Leo's overnight bag.

The offsite is Thu 12 Nov. If tomorrow is Fri 9 Oct, that's 23 business days up to Wed 11 Nov, skipping weekends and Thanksgiving Monday, or 24 counting the offsite day itself. I'm not certain of today's date from here, so please treat that as provisional. Action: confirm today's date, rerun the count, and list the deadlines inside that runway, like Tom's memo comments and the Q1 page due 6 Nov.

You should be proud. Leading Instant Payouts end to end as a senior PM and watching it work is a big deal, and it's good to say it out loud. Action: add it to your career wins note, shipped Instant Payouts launch at Lumen Pay in May 2026, first project led end to end as a senior PM, unless you'd rather I didn't.

Done, Jess from Rover it is. That's $75 a week, about $325 a month. Monday is also the cabinet delivery morning, so someone will need to be home then, though Jess's noon walk is fine. Action: add a recurring event Mon/Wed/Fri at 12:00 starting Monday 10 Nov, and add $75 a week for Jess to the pet budget.

Fun trip, and Leo will love the dinosaurs. I'll look at hotels for 3 nights in Drumheller for the week of the 16th and Tyrrell admission for him, but I won't book anything since those are likely over $100. Action: research hotels and Tyrrell child tickets, then send you a short list with prices and dates to approve before any booking.

Booking East End Plumbing for Monday morning, 29 Jun. For the Lattice self-review due 2026-07-10, I'll set two reminders. Action: book East End for Monday 29 Jun, then add a reminder to start the self-review on Tue 30 Jun and a second one on Mon 6 Jul, the week it's due, and tell you if you'd prefer different days.

On it. Since Leo has a tree nut allergy, I'll check the labels on the lunch items like yogurt tubes and bread for nut warnings. I'll skip the PEC permit until you've talked to Sam. Action: build the grocery order with everything on your list, check nut warnings, and send you the cart with a total and a pickup or delivery time to approve before I place it.

I don't have your Lisbon notes in front of me, so I won't guess what's in them. Action: open the Lisbon note, pull what you saved for New Year's Eve, and add a typical December Lisbon weather range with packing suggestions for Leo.

I don't have how you said you learn Spanish best saved here, and I don't want to make it up. Action: search your Spanish notes and earlier chats for your learning style and the vocab you wanted, then set up tonight's practice around it; if I can't find it, I'll ask you two quick questions first.
He's clearly decided you owe him something, and beagles hold a grudge until it's paid in snacks. Action: nothing needed.

Sending the school council email now. For the insurance, a good rule is to start getting quotes about 4 to 6 weeks before renewal, and don't cancel until the new policy is in force. Notice rules vary by insurer, so I'll check your letter for the renewal date and cancellation terms. Action: send the email, then read the insurance letter and tell you the renewal date, how to cancel and any fees.

From today's chat, it's the couch cushion fort that Biscuit has taken over. I don't have a saved list of Leo's current interests or food restrictions, and I'd rather not guess on food for Grace. Action: check your notes for Leo's interests and any foods to avoid, then draft a short reply for Grace for you to confirm.

I know Nate is your kitchen contractor, but I don't have the reasons you chose him over the other two saved here. Action: open the reno notes and any quote comparisons in your email, pull out the reasons for choosing Nate, and send Sam a short summary.

On it. I'll put together a short note for Tanvi with the key points: a 2010 condo is under rent control, anything above the guideline needs LTB approval, and the landlord must give 90 days' written notice on Form N1, no more than once every 12 months. Action: create the note with links to the official Ontario sources, double-check the current guideline percentage, and send you the link to forward.

Booking it as a 25-minute meeting with an agenda, per your usual rule. Action: find a morning next week that works for you, Aisha and Diego, then book 'Payouts dashboard: empty states' for 25 minutes with the agenda 1) empty-state copy 2) loading skeleton 3) who owns the Looker link.

Lovely, a visit to meet Ira, who'll be about five months old by then. Action: check rough flight prices Toronto to Vancouver for the August long weekend 2026, for one traveller and for two, and send you ranges by airline without booking anything.
Added. Action: add 'get passport photos for Leo' to your to-do list with no due date.

Holding the order, nothing has been reserved or bought. I don't have your basement kitchen setup in front of me, so I don't want to list equipment from memory. Action: search your notes for the basement kitchen setup and send you what you have, so you can plan this week's meals.

Here's a doctor's visit set as a table from now on:
| Spanish | English | Example |
| el dolor | pain | Tengo dolor de cabeza. |
| la fiebre | fever | Tengo fiebre desde ayer. |
| la tos | cough | Tengo tos desde hace tres días. |
| la receta | prescription | ¿Necesito una receta? |
| el síntoma | symptom | ¿Cuáles son sus síntomas? |
| la alergia | allergy | ¿Tiene alguna alergia a medicamentos? |
Action: save the table format for all your future Spanish vocab lists, and offer to expand this into a longer set for Tuesday's role-play with Carlos.

That's frustrating, especially with no note. I don't have your insurer's details in front of me, so I'll find them first. Before filing, take photos of the damage and the lot, and note where and roughly when it happened. Action: find your auto policy and claims contact, check your deductible against the likely repair cost and the premium impact, then draft the claim for your review.
